notice.title: Before you start
notice.intro: Three short things to know. This is a placeholder notice that is still waiting for legal review.

what.title: What this app is
what.body: A self-help tool for noticing how you are doing and trying small things. It is not therapy, it cannot diagnose anything, and it is not an emergency service.

private.title: What happens to what you enter
private.body: Your check-ins, episodes and safety plan are stored for you alone. The words you write are encrypted. Nobody monitors them, and nothing is shared unless you turn sharing on yourself.

control.title: What you control
control.body: You can download everything held about you, and delete your account and its data, at any time in Settings.

preferences.title: Make it comfortable
preferences.intro: All optional. You can change any of this later in Settings.
